summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of AI Mood Mirror app with 3 new features. Backend APIs fully functional with real Gemini 3 Flash integration including vision analysis. Frontend UI working perfectly with all input modes, journal functionality, and navigation. All new features (drawing vision analysis, audio waveform visualization, mood journal) working as expected.
passed_tests: Homepage loads with 'Mood Mirror' title, Journal button, and History button in header
Text input flow: type text → Mirror Me → full analysis shows dominant mood, emotion chart, AI response
Drawing input: canvas renders with color palette, brush size slider, drawing detection works
'AI Vision enabled' badge displays correctly for drawing input
Drawing analysis sends actual base64 image data to Gemini 3 Flash for visual mood analysis
Speech input UI: waveform canvas, record button, analyze button render correctly
MoodResult page shows 'Save to Mood Journal' button after analysis
Save to Journal flow: click save → note input → confirm → success message displays
Journal page accessible via nav button, shows entries with expandable emotion breakdown
Journal trends view toggle works, displays mood trend chart with Recharts
Time filters (7d/30d/90d) functional in journal trends view
Journal delete functionality working (tested via backend API)
Navigation: clicking 'Mood Mirror' logo returns to mirror view from any page
All three input tabs (Write, Draw, Speak) accessible and switchable
Backend API: POST /api/analyze works for text, drawing (vision), speech input
Backend API: POST /api/journal/save saves analysis to journal with notes
Backend API: GET /api/journal returns journal entries with time filtering
Backend API: GET /api/journal/trends returns aggregated trend data
Backend API: DELETE /api/journal/{id} removes entries correctly
Error handling: 422 validation errors, 404 for nonexistent resources
Real Gemini 3 Flash integration working (no mocked APIs)
Drawing vision analysis processes actual image content for mood detection
Audio waveform visualization using Web Audio API canvas (UI renders correctly)
Dark theme (#030303) with glassmorphism design and proper contrast maintained

success_percentage.backend: 100% (12/12 tests passed including new journal endpoints)
success_percentage.frontend: 100% (all UI elements, interactions, and new features working)
success_percentage.integration: 100% (full end-to-end flows working with real AI integration)
